meta.title: noergo — where your thoughts take shape
meta.description: Thoughts on boards, seen as columns, cards or a mind map. Talk it through with ChatGPT, Grok or Claude, and noergo draws it, live.

agents.title: Think out loud with your agents
agents.lead: Connect ChatGPT, Grok, Claude or any MCP client. They read your boards and write on them as you talk, and you watch the mind map grow in noergo.
agents.notEnabled: On this noergo, the administrator enables agents account by account. Ask them to enable yours.
agents.try: Open a thought’s mind map in noergo and say: “Build a mind map here about a slow trip along the coast.”

grok.name: Grok
grok.steps: On grok.com, open Connectors → New connector → Custom. Paste the server address and sign in to noergo when asked. Grok uses connectors in chat and in voice mode.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.steps: On chatgpt.com, turn on Developer mode (Settings → Apps), then create an app with the server address and OAuth sign-in. Writing needs a Business, Enterprise or Edu workspace; on Pro, ChatGPT can only search and read. Voice mode is not documented to call apps; dictating into the chat works.

claude.name: Claude
claude.steps: On claude.ai, Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Paste the server address and sign in to noergo when asked.

claudeCode.name: Claude Code
claudeCode.steps: Run: claude mcp add --transport http noergo {url}, then /mcp to sign in.

cursor.name: Cursor and other MCP clients
cursor.steps: Add a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with the server address. Clients that cannot sign in through OAuth can use a personal token below, sent as Authorization: Bearer.
